description: A request for an unregistered registry DID answered with the document of the resolving registry's own DID, the substitution measured against the reference deployment (Section 4.2). The issuingRegistry is the pinned registry, so the Section 3.5 check passes; the resolved id differs from the requested DID, so a verifier rejects the resolution under Section 6.5.

verificationMethod.publicKeyMultibase: z6Mk<base58btc of 0xed01 || registry Ed25519 public key>
